notes:
What's new in 2.0.8 - the built-in player works without VLC/mpv:
- On PCs with Intel/AMD graphics (Skylake / RX460 or newer), HEVC streams now play directly in the built-in player using hardware decoding
- On older PCs without HEVC hardware, the built-in player can now transcode HEVC to H.264 with ffmpeg (Settings > Player) - install ffmpeg if you don't have VLC or mpv
- Seeking works in transcode mode
- 'Play here (transcoded)' added to the format-unsupported dialog
